title: Streaming
summary: Connected TV. OTT. Digital video. More households than ever are streaming content. For consumers, this means richer and more diverse experiences. For advertisers, this means new opportunities to reach - and engage with - consumers. And these opportunities are growing fast.
body_markdown:
## Your connection to everything CTV


**Cross-platform Campaign Measurement**


Comscore Campaign Ratings™ is the industry’s leading advertising measurement solution offering in-flight deduplicated reach and frequency audience insights across linear TV, Connected TV (CTV), desktop and mobile.


[Read more](https://www.comscore.com/Products/Advertising/Cross-Platform-Campaign-Results)


**Privacy-forward Programmatic Targeting**


Achieve precision CTV programmatic targeting based on behaviors such as YouTube CTV watchers, OTT SVOD watchers, premium sports paid subscribers, and streaming DVR paid subscribers.


[Read more](https://www.comscore.com/Products/Programmatic-Targeting/Cookie-free-Targeting-Solution)


**Multi-Platform Video Measurement**


Comscore Video Metrix® Multi-Platform delivers a total view of consumer digital video consumption across desktops, smartphones, tablets and CTV devices.


[Read More](https://www.comscore.com/Products/Digital/Multi-Platform-Video-Measurement)


**Streaming Insights**


Comscore OTT Intelligence™ provides clients with critical insight into consumer over-the-top (OTT) streaming activity on TV-connected devices, including smart TVs, streaming sticks and boxes and gaming consoles.


[Read More](https://www.comscore.com/Products/CTV/Streaming-Insights)


**Connected Device Insights**


Comscore Connected Home™ enables users to better understand consumer engagement with technology and media by measuring behavior across every network- or router-connected device in the home.


[Read More](https://www.comscore.com/Products/CTV/Connected-Device-Insights)
